theorem: For every odd prime power q, rank_F2(M)=(q+1)^2/2 for the Pass5580 projectivity-graph incidence matrix.
published_module_input: Over Fbar_2 the natural degree-(q+1) PSL2(q) permutation module has Loewy layers 1 | (U_+ direct-sum U_-) | 1 with dim U_+=dim U_-=(q-1)/2.
boundary: This theorem is for the projectivity-graph design. It does not prove the distinct W(3,q) footprint-rank conjecture and implies no q>3 polytope or physics identification.
